transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

I’ve been feeling incredibly depressed and empty inside, and it has been like this for about 11 months now. There is just this constant, heavy sadness that I can't seem to shake. I feel completely hollow.

During these past 11 months, have there been any periods of a few weeks or longer where your mood lifted significantly and you felt like your normal self, or has this heavy sadness been present almost every single day?

No, my mood hasn't lifted at all. This heavy sadness has been present almost every single day for the entire 11 months. It has just been a continuous, unrelenting gloom without any break or feeling like my normal self.
To better understand the impact on your daily life, have you been experiencing significant changes in your sleep, appetite, or energy levels during this time?

Yes, my energy is completely gone, and I’ve had this overwhelming physical and mental fatigue for the last 11 months that makes even simple tasks feel exhausting. As for my sleep and appetite, I haven't really noticed any major changes in those areas. It's just a constant, heavy exhaustion that never goes away.
During this time, have you lost interest or pleasure in activities that you used to enjoy, or is your main struggle the feeling of constant sadness and fatigue?

Honestly, I struggle with both of those things. I have completely lost interest and pleasure in everything I used to enjoy, while also constantly dealing with a deep sadness and heavy fatigue that makes even simple daily tasks feel impossible.
Since you have been experiencing such a profound loss of interest along with constant fatigue, have you had any thoughts of ending your life or feeling that life is no longer worth living?
No, I haven't had any thoughts of ending my life or wanting to die. Even though everything feels incredibly heavy and exhausting, I don't have those kinds of thoughts.
Beyond the fatigue and loss of interest, have you been experiencing other symptoms like difficulty concentrating, feelings of worthlessness, or excessive guilt?

No, I haven't really felt worthless or experienced excessive guilt. My concentration is mostly fine too, even though I am very tired. It is really just the constant sadness and lack of energy that dominates everything.
